question: Is 'R' the correct third entry (index 2) of the detected consume-edge list for Syndra's derived rotation order?

step_1_semantics.claim: 'consume' is the payoff side of the rotation resolver's auto-detected setup/consume edges: abilities whose effect depends on something a prior ability applied.
step_1_semantics.source: data/worklists/f3-task.md, deliverable 1a: 'DETECT setup/consume edges automatically from the ability rows + module metadata: an ability whose row names indicate application (poison/blemish/stack/mark/amp/slow/root/stun/on-hit) must precede abilities that consume (enhanced/consume/detonate/bonus-vs/X-stack/%missing)'. Invariant 2a/2c: the derived order never violates a detected setup/consume edge, and the edge set is champion-level and deterministic.

step_2_setup_side.claim: Syndra's single intra-rotation applier is Q (Dark Sphere), which produces the Dark Spheres every other ability feeds on. Q itself consumes nothing supplied by another ability, so Q is setup, never consume.
step_2_setup_side.quote: Q Dark Sphere - 'Active: Syndra conjures a Dark Sphere at the target location that appears after a 0.6-second delay, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies. The Dark Sphere then remains on the ground for 6 seconds.' Transcendent Bonus: 'Collecting 40 Splinters of Wrath causes Syndra to periodically stock a Dark Sphere charge, up to a maximum of 2.' (data/champions.json -> Syndra.abilities.Q)

W.quote: 'Active: Syndra telekinetically grabs the nearest Dark Sphere, enemy minion or non-epic monster within 500 units from the target location... Recast: Syndra throws the grabbed target towards the target location... dealing magic damage to them and nearby enemies once they land.' (data/champions.json -> Syndra.abilities.W)
W.reasoning: W has no self-supplied ammo; in a coupled champion-vs-champion scenario no minions or non-epic monsters exist, so the only grabbable object is a Q-produced Dark Sphere. W is therefore strictly gated on Q -> a Q->W consume edge.

E.quote: 'Dark Spheres can be knocked back for 950 units and up to 1200 units away from Syndra based on proximity, knocking back enemies they hit over 70 units... Targets hit are also stunned for 1.25 seconds, during which they are also revealed, and dealt Scatter the Weak's damage if they were not damaged by the initial cast.' (data/champions.json -> Syndra.abilities.E)
E.reasoning: E's stun and its second damage application exist only when a live Dark Sphere is in the cone. Without a prior Q, E is a bare cone knockback -> a Q->E consume edge.

R.verdict: consumer (strongest signal of the three; quantitatively provable)
R.quote: 'Active: Syndra conjures 3 Dark Spheres and additionally grabs up to 4 nearby live ones. Afterwards, she barrages the target enemy champion with all collected Dark Spheres, each dealing magic damage upon hit.' Leveling rows: 'Magic Damage per Sphere' = 80/120/160 (+20% AP); 'Minimum Magic Damage' = 240/360/480 (+60% AP); 'Maximum Magic Damage' = 560/840/1120 (+140% AP). Note: 'A sphere summoned very shortly before Unleashed Power will be used as one of the spheres that get thrown.' (data/champions.json -> Syndra.abilities.R)

arithmetic_check.delta: max - min = 320/480/640 (+80% AP) = exactly 4 x per-sphere = the 4 grabbable live Q spheres
arithmetic_check.conclusion: R's damage is an affine function of the pre-existing live Dark Sphere count, floor 3 (self-conjured) and ceiling 7 (3 + 4 grabbed). The entire 4-sphere delta is supplied by prior Q casts, so Q must precede R -> a Q->R consume edge. Confirmed independently by data/champion-audit/batch-6.json, which records 'R sphere count (r_spheres)' and 'damage (Q/W/E nukes, R multi-sphere, 19 atoms)' for the Syndra module.

P.verdict: not a cast; innate stack source (Splinters of Wrath), never appears in a cast-order list

step_4_keyword_cross_check.note: A second, independent reading of the f3-task.md keyword taxonomy ('enhanced/consume/...') lands on the same set. The three Transcendent rows that use the word 'enhance' belong to W ('Collecting 60 Splinters of Wrath enhances Force of Will to deal 12% (+ 2% per 100 AP) bonus true damage'), E ('Collecting 80 Splinters of Wrath enhances Scatter the Weak...'), and R ('Collecting 100 Splinters of Wrath enhances Unleashed Power to execute the target...'). Q's Transcendent row says 'stock', a production word, keeping Q on the setup side. Both the mechanical (Dark Sphere) reading and the keyword reading yield consume = {W, E, R}.

step_5_index.ordering: R is last under both plausible conventions: ability-slot order (P,Q,W,E,R -> W,E,R) and derived-cast order (R is the single-cast finisher; docs/math-foundations.md, ability-rotation row: 'R single-cast' / 'R casts exactly once per timed fight').

step_6_scenario_suffix.note: '60' is the splinters option pinned by the scenario (the 60-Splinter W true-damage threshold; data/champion-audit/batch-6.json: 'splinters option (0-120) gates Q2 second charge, W 60-splinter true-damage'). It does not change the consume set: R's 3-to-7 sphere consumption is baseline, ungated by Splinters, and the F3 invariant requires the edge set to be a deterministic champion-level property. Omitting R at 60 Splinters because R's 100-Splinter execute is inactive would be a category error - the execute is a Transcendent rider, not the sphere-consumption mechanic.

independent_computation.why_old_value_is_wrong: An absent third entry means the consume list did not carry R. No consistent detector can flag W and E as sphere consumers while excluding R: R's evidence is a strict superset in kind - explicit 'grabs up to 4 nearby live ones' text PLUS a leveling table whose min/max rows arithmetically encode the 3-to-7 sphere dependence. A rotation whose consume set omits R permits an order that fires R before any Q sphere exists, costing exactly 4 x (80/120/160 + 20% AP) = 320/480/640 (+80% AP) magic damage at ranks 1/2/3.
